definitions.explanation: Acting on sudden impulses or changing moods unpredictably.
A sudden, impulsive action or decision (noun usage).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{気|き}まぐれな{性格|せいかく}だ。
{気|き}まぐれで{髪|かみ}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut my hair on a whim.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}は{気|き}まぐれな{動物|どうぶつ}だ。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{気|き} (mind, mood) + まぐれ (random, chance) → random mood = capricious

FORMS:
・{気|き}まぐれな{人|ひと} - a capricious person
・{気|き}まぐれで - on a whim
・{気|き}まぐれに - capriciously

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{気|き}まぐれな{天気|てんき} - unpredictable weather
・{気|き}まぐれな{猫|ねこ} - a capricious cat
・{気|き}まぐれで{買|か}う - to buy on impulse

NUANCE:
Can be used neutrally (describing unpredictability), positively (charmingly spontaneous), or negatively (unreliable). Often used affectionately for cats and similar behaviors.
